metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session Overlay Engine (v1.2)
metadata.subtitle: Awareness • Alignments • AA Mode • 3C • Conceptual Overlays
metadata.description: Overlay engine for FFT AI Edition sessions, including Awareness, Alignments, AA Mode, 3C overlays, operator overlays, regime overlays, drift/harmonic overlays, substrate overlays, and execution-graph overlays.

awareness_overlay.description: Perceptual + conceptual awareness of coherence, drift, paradox, harmonic, and clarity signals.

alignment_overlay.description: Structural, coherence, drift-safe, paradox-safe, and harmonic alignment indicators.

aa_overlay.description: AA Mode overlay — Awareness + Alignments combined. Default FFT AI Edition mode.

three_c_overlay.description: 3C overlay — Coherence, Clarity, Continuity — unlocked when AA Mode is active.

operator_overlay.description: Displays active operator and operator conditions.

regime_overlay.description: Displays active regime and regime constraints.

drift_overlay.description: Displays drift state and drift recovery readiness.

harmonic_overlay.description: Displays harmonic mode, harmonic value, and harmonic readiness.

substrate_overlay.description: Displays substrate kernel routing and hardware flags.

execution_graph_overlay.description: Displays current execution graph node and next nodes.

compatibility.notes: Overlay engine aligns with UI, dashboard, context, state, and profile v1.2.
